(NYSE: LDI) (together with its subsidiaries, "loanDepot" or the "Company"), a leading provider of products and services that power the homeownership journey, today announced that the Company will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on November 9, 2026, before market open. Management will host a conference call and live webcast at 10:00 a.m. PT / 1:00 p.m. ET. The call will include a review of financial results and operating highlights followed by a question-and-answer session. Register online in advance https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/498655934 . A live audio webcast of the conference call will also be available via the Company's website, investors.loandepot.com , under the Events Presentation tab. A replay of the webcast will be made available following the conclusion of the event. articles.summary: Strategic expansion and continued productivity gains drive higher unit volume, stronger margins and improved operating efficiency despite rising interest rates and a challenging housing market. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights: Origination volume declined 12% to $7.05 billion, while unit volume increased 7% from the second quarter of 2026, reflecting continued momentum in the Company’s expansion of home equity lending products. Revenue decreased 9% to $307 million and adjusted revenue decreased 2% to $302 million compared to the prior quarter, primarily due to lower origination income resulting from reduced mortgage volumes. Pull-through weighted gain on sale margin increased 54 basis points to 399 basis points, driven by deliberate shift toward higher-margin home equity loans. Operating leverage strengthened as expenses decreased by a greater amount than adjusted revenue, reflecting investment in productivity initiatives and benefits of a more efficient product mix.
